item.title: Matt Mullenweg tells Automattic staff in Slack he's back in control after ouster
item.description:
📝 The post arrives only days after Automattic’s board voted to oust Mullenweg as CEO for unknown reasons. At the time, a spokesperson from Automattic confirmed to TechCrunch that Mullenweg was on leave and Davies was interim CEO. However, TechCrunch heard yesterday that Mullenweg had removed all Slack admins from the Automattic Slack and made an odd post about being a “pirate” in which he cursed.
🔗 Read more: https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/11/matt-mullenweg-tells-automattic-staff-in-slack-hes-back-in-control-after-ceo-ouster/
